title: Foundations
summary: Access now comes only from the approved intranet groups, sensitive pages ask you to sign in again, and admins have new tools to keep the intranet healthy.

added: A plain-English guide, Who can see what, under Support.
Sensitive pages, such as HR and agreements, ask you to sign in again if your last sign-in was a while ago.
For admins: a System status page, outage emails, a test email button, a Roles page that shows each group, and a quarterly access review.
changed: Only the eight approved intranet groups give access. Anyone else sees a No intranet access page.
security: The rules on who can see HR, DBS, health and legal records are enforced on every page, and each look at those records is logged.

internal_notes: The main branch accepts merge commits only, and dependency updates collect on a separate branch that each milestone merges in.
Live Cloudron addon settings are read before the local settings file, so rotated passwords and restores keep working.
